symptom: Every domain-model rewrite deletes MaybeGeneralization HasOwnerAttr/HasChangedByAttr/HasCreatedDateAttr/HasChangedDateAttr = false on Studio Pro entities (#721 B)
cause: entityToGen set only the true flags, for parity with the legacy serializer
insight: Legacy-writer parity is not Studio Pro parity; the flags were the last getput loss of a Studio Pro external entity, which is why it surfaced in #743
